summary: Full E2E test of AaicheLadau. Backend: 26 pytest cases, 25 passed; the only failure is the brute-force lockout. Frontend: all 10 requested flows pass. Landing shows 4 combos and the category tabs work. Pack price updates. Cart fee is 500 for India and 1400 for Abroad (1.5 kg); with exact rounding it is 375. Checkout shows the 503 toast without crashing (expected, since the Razorpay keys are placeholders). Laado chat streams replies, gives the fallback line for unrelated questions and saves a Hot lead with summary and WhatsApp message (copy works). Feedback rejects a wrong phone and a duplicate, and a published testimonial shows publicly. Stock 0 shows Out of stock on the item and its combos. Admin combo add/edit/delete, order status change, 401 without auth and the 390px mobile layout all work.

minor.issue: Brute-force lockout never triggers in this preview environment: 6 bad attempts all return 401 and none return 429. RCA: the identifier is f'{request.client.host}:{email}', and client.host is the rotating ingress pod IP (seen 10.30.130.133 and 10.219.0.199), so the count is split across records. Fix: use the first IP in the X-Forwarded-For header, or key on email only. Also, once a lock expires the count stays >=5, so the next single failure locks again immediately; reset the count when locked_until has passed.
Return ok:true even when the id does not exist (should return 404). Deleting a product used in a combo leaves the combo showing 'Item removed' and marked out of stock, with no warning.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True. The playbook asks for explicit origins.

ui_bugs.issue: Assistant replies show raw markdown (e.g. '- **Name:** TEST_Priya') because the LLM uses markdown and the bubble renders plain text. Either render the markdown or tell the model in the system prompt to reply in plain text without markdown.
